The same table annotates openings and closings in parentheses -- e.g. 'Jonction Bel Air (closed
1-9-17) P.Q' and 'Jesmond (opened 1-3-18) B.C' a few hundred lines earlier. Kanawana carries
'(summer office)' and no opening or closing note.
